_about: Public-domain Henry Scott Holland (1847-1918, canon of St Paul's and Regius Professor of Divinity at Oxford) for the Word Hoard: 20 books from Internet Archive scans, 1882-1923, among them Logic and Life (1882), Creed and Character (1887), On Behalf of Belief (1889), The Real Problem of Eschatology (1916) and the posthumous The Philosophy of Faith and the Fourth Gospel (1920). Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
